shortDescription.default: An interactive SharePoint org chart web part, no admin consent required.

longDescription.default: A modern org chart web part that reads the reporting line from the user profile service. Drill through the org, start from anyone with a people picker, expand reports inline, open a full-screen explorer with search and zoom, email or Teams-chat each person, and optionally show live Teams presence.

features.title: react-org-chart Feature
features.description: Activates the Org Chart web part.
